name: Lyubov nadaye kryla
source:
While reading isekai novels, Stasya could never have imagined that she would one day experience it herself.  She was sure that she'd be able to cope with all the difficulties in no time, and that she would be lying on her favorite couch with a 50₴ face mask by dusk. 

It was a big surprise, to put it mildly, that her way home was to participate in the dubious game show Love Gives Wings. Now Stasya had to win the heart of a bachelorette--an enigmatic necromancer who possessed a strange artifact...

[Translated/Edited from [url=https://ihrytavarennia.itch.io/lubovtakryla]itch.io[/url]]
